TeacherCloudProfile.title: Teacher Cloud Profile
TeacherCloudProfile.description: Compact teacher account metadata, default race settings, and Firebase Spark Free Tier retention controls.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher who owns this profile.

email.description: Verified teacher email address (PII, owner-only readable).

maxArchivedMatches.description: Auto-cleanup retention cap (between 5 and 25 matches) to keep Firestore Spark storage lean.

retentionDays.description: Auto-cleanup age limit in days (between 7 and 90 days).

defaultQuestionCount.description: Default number of questions per race (5 to 100).

defaultMaxPlayers.description: Default max participants per race (2 to 30).

defaultTimePerQuestion.description: Default timer in seconds per question (5 to 120).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud profile was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

QuestionPack.title: Compact Question Pack
QuestionPack.description: Bundled pack of up to 50 quiz questions stored in 1 compact Firestore document to minimize Spark read/write quota usage.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning teacher.

packIndex.description: Zero-based pack slot index (0 to 9, max 500 questions per teacher).

questionCount.description: Number of questions inside this pack (0 to 50).

approxBytes.description: Approximate compact payload size in bytes for quota monitoring.

questions.description: Bounded array of up to 50 compact question objects (native Firestore maps, no JSON strings).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this pack was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest pack sync.

MatchArchive.title: Compact Match Archive
MatchArchive.description: Ultra-compact 1-document summary of a finished match (metadata + Top 30 standings, zero per-answer bloat) locked in terminal archived state.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning teacher.

roomName.description: Display name of the finished match.

questionCount.description: Total questions used in the match (1 to 100).

totalLaps.description: Computed total laps in the race (1 to 20).

participantCount.description: Number of participants in this match (0 to 30).

status.description: Terminal archived state preventing post-archive tampering.

approxBytes.description: Approximate compact document size in bytes.

standings.description: Bounded array of up to 30 compact participant result maps.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the match archive was stored (immutable).

AdminAccount.title: Admin Account Record
AdminAccount.description: Trusted admin registry document keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Only the verified bootstrap admin may create or revoke admin records.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authorized admin.

grantedBy.description: UID of the bootstrap admin who created this record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin role was granted (immutable).

StadiumLedConfig.title: Stadium Perimeter LED Ribbon Config
StadiumLedConfig.description: Single ultra-lean global configuration document for the 360-degree lower grandstand LED perimeter board supporting rotating running text and heavily compressed sponsor images (<= 320 KB total).

enabled.description: Master switch to enable or disable custom perimeter LED playback.

repeatCount.description: Number of full-width LED panels tiled around the 360-degree stadium perimeter (12 to 40).

approxBytes.description: Exact UTF-8 byte size of the serialized configuration (capped at 320000 bytes to protect Firebase Spark Free Tier quota).

slides.description: Bounded playlist of 1 to 10 alternating running text or compressed sponsor image slides.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified admin who saved this configuration.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest admin update.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Trusted admin registry for cross-teacher Spark storage cleanup and retention management.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Publicly readable, admin-only writable global stadium configuration (specifically /settings/stadiumLed for the 360-degree lower grandstand perimeter LED board).

/teachers/{teacherId}.description: Owner-isolated teacher profile and Spark quota retention configuration (contains PII email; readable/deletable by verified admin).

/teachers/{teacherId}/questionPacks/{pac.description: Compact question packs (max 50 questions per doc, max 10 packs) owned by a teacher and cleanable by verified admin.

/teachers/{teacherId}/matchArchives/{arc.description: Compact 1-doc-per-match finished summaries (auto-pruned by maxArchivedMatches & retentionDays; cleanable by verified admin).
